branded.why: The pull-apart string cheese every Japanese convenience store has carried since 1980.

about.text: A pull-apart string cheese made by Megmilk Snow Brand, first sold in 1980 as string cheese and renamed in 1995. It is not aged: it is warmed, stretched and cooled so that the protein strands align and it tears lengthwise.

sources.text: The maker, the 1980 launch and 1995 rename, and the protein-alignment method.
